title: Add Wave 10 mission control and operator invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add GraphMessage::verify_message_invariants, GraphView::verify_graph_view_invariants, ReplayEvent::verify_replay_event_invariants, and Replay::verify_replay_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/mission_control.rs, plus PlanQueueOptions::verify_plan_options_invariants, AuthorOptions::verify_author_options_invariants, and RunOptions::verify_run_options_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/operator.rs.
